info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Knowledge Assets Intellectual Property Portfolio By Intellectual Property Portfolio Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the modification of knowledge assets within the banking sector by allowing users to update specific intellectual property portfolios. Utilizing the portfolio ID, consumers can alter relevant data and ensure that the portfolio remains current and accurately reflects the organization's intellectual property assets. Typical users of this endpoint include internal banking personnel and application systems responsible for asset management and compliance. Streamlining the update process helps maintain the integrity and value of intellectual property investments.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific intellectual property portfolio identified by the resource ID RES-100045. Ensure to provide the necessary details in the request body to modify the portfolio effectively.

requestBody.description: Updates the metadata or attributes of the specified intellectual property portfolio entry identified by RES-100045. This request should include the fields that need to be updated in the JSON format provided.
